messages.text:
James, your Hammer Thor P2 on Shop···· hasn't shipped yet, but it's moving. The unit is reserved for you at our US warehouse, and the order went into processing there yesterday, so it's being picked and packed now. Nothing is holding it up.

In-stock orders like this one leave within 5 business days. When the label is made, the tracking number is emailed to you. It's going to your FPO AP address.
